reason: I already book my comedy and events on the ticket apps I know, and for smaller things I just WhatsApp the venue or pay at the door. A brand-new app launching 1 November doesn't give me a reason to switch, and the R8 is nothing to me but it's still a fee for something I can already do.
objection: Why download another app when the shows I want are already on the platforms I trust, or I can just message the venue? I don't know who TROVE is yet and I'm not sure it will have anything my usual apps don't.
would_change_my_mind: If TROVE had good experiences I genuinely can't find on my usual apps, like a curated weekend list of sip-and-paint or adventure stuff around Sandton that I'd otherwise have to hunt for on Instagram.
